Title: EVT-OP-016: Anticlustering only up to a block exponent (answered by the library)
Labels: open-problem, area:dependence, type:research, difficulty:small, status:research

**Status in the survey:** Answered by the library. What remains is expert confirmation and the novelty check (roadmap, B, Publication). File this to keep the record, and close it once confirmed.

## Source and quote
Bai, Kulik and Wang, arXiv:2409.17966v2, §1.4:

> It would also be interesting to know whether there are models such that the anticlustering condition holds with $\lim_{n\to\infty}\log d_{n}/\log n=\rho$ for $\rho$ up to certain $\rho_{0}<1$ only.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
It is the library's main new result, and no expert has reviewed it yet.

## What the library already has
`powEchoProcess_antiClustering_iff`, for every `ρ₀ ∈ (0,1)`.

## What is missing
An independent review of the statement against the paper's definition of anticlustering.
